The [iNaturalist Network](https://www.naturalista.uy/sites/network) is a localised experience that is fully connected to the global iNaturalist community. Network members are local institutions that promote local use and facilitate the use of data from iNaturalist to benefit local 

The aim of this report is to give an account of the importance of the iNaturalist network members by analysing the number of records for each country.

```{r}
#| label: libraries
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false


library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)
library(rgbif)
library(ggrepel)
library(extrafont)
library(patchwork)
library(parallel)
library(doParallel)
library(hstats)
library(vip)
library(future)
library(sf)
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
library(tidymodels)
library(tidyverse)  

options(knitr.kable.NA = '') 
options(scipen=999)
```

## iNaturalist National Sites

```{r}
#| label: inat-sites
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| tbl-cap: 'Members of the iNaturalist Network. Shown in green are the sites from Latin America'

inat_network <- read_csv('data/inat_nodes.csv')

inat_network %>% 
  mutate('#'= row_number()) %>% relocate('#') %>% 
  rename(`Country` = node_country,
         `Node name` = node_name,
         `ID`= node_id,
         `Type`=node_type,
         `Year established` = node_year) %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(digits=1) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_material('striped') %>% 
  kableExtra::row_spec(row = c(1,4,7,8,10,11,12,17,21), bold = T, color = "white", background = "#228A22")
```

![](https://static.inaturalist.org/wiki_page_attachments/3354-original.png)

```{r}
#| label: temporal-plot
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| out-width: 100%

ggplot(inat_network, aes(x = node_year, 
                         y = reorder(node_country, node_year),
                         label = node_country)) +
  geom_point(aes(col=node_type), size = 3) +
   scale_colour_manual(values = c('black' , '#228a22',  '#74AC00', '#b2b2b2ff')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2013, 2022, 1)) +
  geom_label_repel(aes(colour=node_type), min.segment.length = 0.1,
                   show.legend = F, max.overlaps= Inf, ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('black','#228a22',  '#74AC00', '#b2b2b2ff')) +
  labs(x = '', y = '', col ='') +
  ggpubr::theme_pubclean() + theme(legend.position = 'bottom', 
                                   axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                                   axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
```

## Methods

We tested different explanatory variables and saw which is the model that best explains the values a country has for iNaturalist. Indicators per country were extracted using the WDI: World Development Indicators (World Bank) on the **26th of September, 2025**. 

**Response variables**:  

  - `n_records`: total number of records on iNaturalist per country.  
  - `p_research_grade`: proportion of records from iNaturalist that are "Research Grade" per country (proxy for quality, research- grade records).  
  - `n_users`: number of users recording in the country (this is not exactly the users from the country, but users that have generated records in the country).  
  - `n_taxa`: number of taxa recorded in the country (this is not necessarily at the species level).

**Explanatory variables**:  

  - `population`: population of the country (*SP.POP.TOTL*).  
  - `area`: area of the country in km^2^ (*AG.SRF.TOTL.K2*).  
  - `gdp_per_capita`: GDP per capita in US dollars (*NY.GDP.PCAP.CD*).  
  - `gdp_in_research`: % of the GDP of the country dedicated to research *GB.XPD.RSDV.GD.ZS*).  
  - `latitude`: country's centroid latitude (as a proxy of expected biodiversity) (using `rnaturalearth` country polygons).  
  - `n_species`: number of species reported for the country (using `rnaturalearth` country polygons).  
  - `has_node`: whether a country has a node on the iNaturalist network.   
  - `neighbour_has_node`: whether a country has a neighbouring country that has a node on the iNaturalist network (using `rnaturalearth` country polygons).  

### Data 

We downloaded the data following

```{r}
#| label: variables
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

data_variables <- readRDS('data/Global_data_variables.rds')
```

## Summary of the data

```{r}
#| label: summary-data
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8

summary_data <- data_variables %>% 
  mutate(is_network =
           case_when(!is.na(node_name) ~ 'Network',
                     country_name == 'United States' ~ 'United States',
                     .default = 'Rest of the world')) %>%
  relocate(is_network) %>%
  group_by(is_network) %>% 
  summarise(n_records = sum(n_records), 
            n_users = sum(n_users), 
            n_taxa = sum(n_taxa), 
            p_research_grade_mean = round(mean(p_research_grade),3),
            p_research_grade_sd = round(sd(p_research_grade),3))

summary_data %>%
  mutate(per_records = round(n_records*100/sum(n_records),1)) %>%
  mutate(per_users = round(n_users*100/sum(n_users),1)) %>%
  mutate(per_taxa = round(n_taxa*100/sum(n_taxa),1)) %>%
  relocate(per_records, .after = n_records) %>% 
  relocate(per_users, .after = n_users) %>% 
  relocate(per_taxa, .after = n_taxa) %>% 
  janitor::adorn_totals('row', ,,, n_records, n_users, n_taxa) %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(col.names = c('Network', 'Observations', '(%)',
                                'Users', '(%)',
                                'Taxa', '(%)',
                                'Proportion of RG', 'sd'),
                  digits=3, format.args = list(big.mark = ',')) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_material('striped')

summary_plot_n_records <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x=is_network)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y=n_records, fill=is_network),
           stat = 'identity',
           show.legend = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#74AC00',  '#b2b2b2ff', 'black')) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = c(m = 1000000))) +
  labs(x = '', y = 'Number of records') +
  ggpubr::theme_pubclean()

summary_plot_n_users <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x=is_network)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y=n_users, fill=is_network),
           stat = 'identity',
           show.legend = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#74AC00',  '#b2b2b2ff', 'black')) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = c(m = 1000000))) +
  labs(x = '', y = 'Number of users') +
  ggpubr::theme_pubclean()

summary_plot_n_taxa <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x=is_network)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y=n_taxa, fill=is_network),
           stat = 'identity',
           show.legend = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#74AC00',  '#b2b2b2ff', 'black')) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = c(m = 1000000)), 
                     limits = c(0,1500000)) +
  labs(x = '', y = 'Number of taxa') +
  ggpubr::theme_pubclean()


summary_plot_p_research_grade_mean <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x=is_network)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y=p_research_grade_mean, fill=is_network),
           stat = 'identity',
           show.legend = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#74AC00',  '#b2b2b2ff', 'black')) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1)) +
  labs(x = '', y = 'Proportion of Research Grade records') +
  ggpubr::theme_pubclean()

(summary_plot_n_records + summary_plot_n_users) / (summary_plot_n_taxa + summary_plot_p_research_grade_mean)
```

## Summary of the data for the Network members

```{r}
#| label: site-variables
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

data_variables %>% filter(!is.na(node_name)) %>% 
  select(country_name, node_name, 
         n_records, p_research_grade, n_users, n_taxa) %>% 
  arrange(country_name, n_records) %>% 
  rename(Country=country_name,
         Node=node_name, 
         `Observations`= n_records,
         `% Research Grade` = p_research_grade,
         `Users`= n_users,
         `Taxa`= n_taxa) %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(digits=3, format.args = list(big.mark = ',')) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_material('striped') 
```

### Total number of records on iNaturalist per country

```{r}
#| label: n_inat_country
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

ids <- data_variables %>% 
  select(country_name,node_name, n_records) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n_records)) %>% 
  with(which(!is.na(node_name)))

data_variables %>% 
  select(country_name,node_name, n_records) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n_records)) %>% 
  mutate('#'= row_number()) %>% relocate('#') %>% 
  rename(`Country` = country_name,
         `Node` = node_name,
         `Observations`=n_records) %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(digits=4, format.args = list(big.mark = ',')) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_material('striped') %>% 
  kableExtra::row_spec(ids, bold = T, color = "white", background = "#228A22") %>% 
  kableExtra::scroll_box(height = '600px')
```

## Associations between variables

### Population of the country

```{r}
#| label: population-plot
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: 
#| - 'Number of records on iNaturalist vs Population of the country'
#| - 'Proportion of Research Grade iNat records vs Population of the country'
#| - 'Number of users recording on iNaturalist vs Population of the country'
#| - 'Number of taxa recorded on iNaturalist vs Population of the country'

## records
ggplot(data_variables %>% mutate(has_node = as.character(has_node)), 
       aes(population/100000, n_records/1000, label = node_name)) +
  geom_point(aes(col=has_node), size=2, show.legend = F) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('black', '#74AC00')) +
  geom_smooth(method='lm', colour = 'black') +
  geom_abline(lwd = 1.5, linetype = 'dashed', col = 'orange') +
  geom_label_repel(aes(fill=has_node), 
                   colour = "black", #fontface = "bold",
                   segment.color = 'black',
                   show.legend = F, max.overlaps= Inf) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#F7F7F7', '#74AC00')) +
  labs(x='Population of the country (hundred thousand)',
       y='Number of records on iNaturalist (thousand)') +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  theme_bw()

## records in research_grade
ggplot(data_variables %>% mutate(has_node = as.character(has_node)), 
       aes(population/100000, p_research_grade, label = node_name)) +
  geom_point(aes(col=has_node), size=2, show.legend = F) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('black', '#74AC00')) +
  geom_smooth(method='lm', colour = 'black') +
  geom_abline(lwd = 1.5, linetype = 'dashed', col = 'orange') +
  geom_label_repel(aes(fill=has_node), 
                   colour = "black", #fontface = "bold",
                   segment.color = 'black',
                   show.legend = F, max.overlaps= Inf) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#F7F7F7', '#74AC00')) +
  labs(x='Population of the country (hundred thousand)',
       y='Proportion of iNat records that reach Research Grade') +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  theme_bw()

## users
ggplot(data_variables %>% mutate(has_node = as.character(has_node)), 
       aes(population/100000, n_users, label = node_name)) +
  geom_point(aes(col=has_node), size=2, show.legend = F) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('black', '#74AC00')) +
  geom_smooth(method='lm', col= 'black') +
  geom_abline(lwd = 1.5, linetype = 'dashed', col = 'orange') +
  geom_label_repel(aes(fill=has_node), 
                   colour = "black", #fontface = "bold",
                   segment.color = 'black',
                   show.legend = F, max.overlaps= Inf) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#F7F7F7', '#74AC00')) +
```

## Modelling

```{r}
#| label: data-regressions
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| out-width: 100%

data_regressions <- data_variables %>% 
  select(-c(country_name, region, flag, node_name, node_id, node_type, node_year, place_id)) %>% 
  drop_na(area, population, gdp_per_capita, gdp_in_research, latitude, n_species) %>% 
  filter(country_code != 'US')

###

data_regressions %>% 
  select(area, population, gdp_per_capita,
         gdp_in_research, latitude, n_species, 
         has_node, neighbour_has_node) %>% 
  cor() %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(digits=3, 
                  format.args = list(big.mark = ',')) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_material('striped') 

data_regressions %>% 
  select(area, population, gdp_per_capita,
         gdp_in_research, latitude, n_species, 
         has_node, neighbour_has_node) %>% 
  cor() %>% 
  corrplot::corrplot(method = 'color',
                     diag = FALSE, type = 'lower',
                     order = 'AOE', tl.col = 'grey15') 

data_regressions %>% 
  select(area, population, gdp_per_capita,
         gdp_in_research, latitude, n_species) %>% pairs()
```

## Non-parametric test

```{r}
#| label: non-parametric-test
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| out-width: 100%

boxplot_n_records <- ggplot(data_regressions %>% 
         mutate(has_node = factor(has_node)), 
       aes(x = has_node, y = n_records, fill=has_node)) +
  geom_boxplot(notch = T, linewidth = 0, 
               median.color = "black",
               whisker.linewidth = 0.5,
               median.linewidth = 0.8,
               show.legend = F) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#454545', '#74AC00')) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = c(m = 1000000))) +
  xlab("Node in the iNat Network") +
  ylab("Number of records (log scale)") +
  ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("0", "1")),
                        map_signif_level = TRUE,
                        textsize = 5, vjust = 2) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubclean()

boxplot_n_users <- ggplot(data_regressions %>% 
         mutate(has_node = factor(has_node)),
```

### Total number of records on iNaturalist per country

```{r}
#| label: rf-n_records
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

rf_n_records <- model_iNat_RF(data_df = data_regressions,
                              response_variable = 'n_records',
                              skip_vars = c('p_research_grade',
                                            'n_users',
                                            'n_taxa'))

# tuning
rf_n_records[[1]]

# observed vs predicted (test)
rf_n_records[[2]]

# observed vs predicted (CV)
rf_n_records[[3]]

# variable importance
rf_n_records[[4]]
ggsave(rf_n_records[[4]], filename='figs/variable_importance_n_records.png', device = 'png', dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 8)

# partial plots
rf_n_records[[5]]
ggsave(rf_n_records[[5]], filename='figs/partial_plots_n_records.png', device = 'png', dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 6.5)

# final model metrics rsq
rf_n_records[[6]] %>% 
  select(dataset, rsq=.estimate) %>% 
  mutate(rsq = round(rsq, 3)) %>% 
  rename(`R^2` = rsq) %>% 
  knitr::kable() %>% kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

# final model metrics rmse
rf_n_records[[7]] %>% 
  select(dataset, rmse=.estimate) %>% 
  mutate(rmse = round(rmse, 3)) %>% 
  rename(`RMSE` = rmse) %>% 
  knitr::kable() %>% kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

# variable importance
rf_n_records[[9]] %>% 
  select(Variable, standardise_Importance, 
         standardise_Importance_R2) %>% 
  mutate(standardise_Importance = standardise_Importance*100) %>% 
  rename(`Importance %` = standardise_Importance,
         `Contribution to R^2` = standardise_Importance_R2) %>% 
  knitr::kable(digits = c(4,1)) %>% kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

```{r}
  mutate(rsq = round(rsq, 3)) %>%

  knitr::kable() %>% kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

# final model metrics rmse
rf_p_research_grade[[7]] %>% 
  select(dataset, rmse=.estimate) %>% 
  mutate(rmse = round(rmse, 3)) %>% 
  rename(`RMSE` = rmse) %>% 
  knitr::kable() %>% kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

# variable importance
rf_p_research_grade[[9]] %>% 
  select(Variable, standardise_Importance, 
         standardise_Importance_R2) %>% 
  mutate(standardise_Importance = standardise_Importance*100) %>% 
  rename(`Importance %` = standardise_Importance,
         `Contribution to R^2` = standardise_Importance_R2) %>% 
  knitr::kable(digits = c(4,1)) %>% kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

### Final numbers

```{r}
#| label: summary-performance
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

bind_rows(
  bind_rows(rf_n_records[[6]], rf_n_records[[7]]) %>% 
    mutate(response = 'n_records'),
    bind_rows(rf_p_research_grade[[6]], rf_p_research_grade[[7]]) %>%
    mutate(response = 'p_research_grade'),
  bind_rows(rf_n_users[[6]], rf_n_users[[7]]) %>% 
    mutate(response = 'n_users'),
  bind_rows(rf_n_taxa[[6]], rf_n_taxa[[7]]) %>% 
    mutate(response = 'n_taxa')
) %>% select(-.estimator) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(dataset, .metric), 
              values_from = .estimate) %>% 
  relocate(train_rmse, .after = train_rsq) %>%
  relocate(test_rmse, .after = test_rsq) %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(col.names = c('Response', 
                                'R2 train', 
                                'RMSE train',
                                'R2 test', 
                                'RMSE test',
                                'R2 CV', 
                                'RMSE CV'),
                  digits=3, format.args = list(big.mark = ',')) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_material('striped') 
```
